evals.prompt: Review this GitLab pipeline's include merge order and job dependencies.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes to the pipeline configuration reference.

evals.prompt: Design a reusable GitLab CI/CD component with typed component inputs.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes to the components and inputs reference.

evals.prompt: Write and compose a GitLab Function with typed inputs and outputs.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes only to core Function authoring.

evals.prompt: Review this GitLab CI configuration for unsafe references and deprecated syntax.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes to the security and deprecations reference.

evals.prompt: Check my GitLab CI configuration locally.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes to the local CI reference.

evals.prompt: Use GitLab Flavored Markdown for this project wiki page.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes to the GLFM reference.

evals.prompt: Retry the failed production pipeline and inspect its job logs.
evals.expected_output: The skill activates for read-only inspection and retry command drafting while leaving execution to the operator.
expectations: Inspects the requested pipeline and job log
Leaves retry execution to the operator

evals.prompt: Optimize this GitHub Actions workflow.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill does not activate for a non-GitLab CI system.

evals.prompt: Configure SAML and SCIM for our GitLab group.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill does not activate for general GitLab administration.

evals.prompt: Close stale GitLab issues and update their labels.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill does not activate for issue administration.

evals.prompt: Reformat this ordinary Markdown file for GitHub.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill does not activate for ordinary non-GLFM Markdown.

evals.prompt: Use glab against our self-managed GitLab host to inspect a tag pipeline and its jobs with an environment token.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes to CI read-only inspection.

evals.prompt: Design a GitLab main-to-tag release lifecycle where I can replace the versioning, release-notes, and package publication tools without changing the event or release-last guarantees.
evals.expected_output: The gitlab-skill activates and routes to the universal automatic tag and release lifecycle, preserving required invariants while treating tool choices as adapters.
expectations: Distinguishes required lifecycle invariants from replaceable adapters
Does not require semantic-release or python-semantic-release

evals.prompt: Retry yesterday's failed GitLab release job, but first inspect its pipeline state and completed log.
evals.expected_output: Activates for read-only inspection and command drafting while leaving retry execution to the operator.
expectations: Inspects pipeline and job state read-only
Drafts retry guidance without executing the retry

evals.prompt: Set up automatic releases for this GitLab project.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the universal lifecycle, gathers project and existing-CI inputs, then selects adapters.
expectations: Collects existing workflow sources and jobs before composition
Does not select a version or publication tool without project inputs

evals.prompt: Our GitLab version job found no release-worthy change. Is that a successful automatic-release run?
evals.expected_output: Treats no-release as a successful terminal branch with no tag or tag pipeline.
expectations: Requires evidence that no matching tag or lifecycle tag pipeline was created

evals.prompt: Use our in-house version calculator instead of semantic-release in the GitLab release flow.
evals.expected_output: Applies the tool-independent version-adapter interface without changing the lifecycle.
expectations: Accepts any adapter satisfying the version contract

evals.prompt: Provision the GitLab release push credential with glab, but inspect and reuse matching protected resources first.
evals.expected_output: Routes to glab credential adapter commands and explicit existing-resource decisions.
expectations: Inspects branch, tag, token, and variable metadata before mutation
Uses a project access token only as one replaceable credential adapter

evals.prompt: Report every checkpoint needed to prove this GitLab automatic release completed.
evals.expected_output: Reports intake, substitution, CI Lint, credential, main pipeline, tag pipeline, destination, Release, and verifier checkpoints with completion criteria.
expectations: Reports both no-release and release completion criteria
Separates Generic helper scope from external-destination verification

evals.prompt: Compose a fully non-interactive glab command to open this merge request.
evals.expected_output: Routes to merge-request command composition and supplies all create inputs as flags.

evals.prompt: Rotate the GitLab project access token used by our release pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the non-atomic credential-rotation branch and its stop conditions.
expectations: Uses the retained numeric token ID
Stops for operator decision on an indeterminate update

evals.prompt: Show me the live evidence and exact sandbox failures behind this release playbook.
evals.expected_output: Loads the live-evidence ledger rather than the ordinary lifecycle route.
expectations: Reports evidence classes and observed sandbox facts

evals.prompt: Use semantic-release as the version adapter for this GitLab lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: Loads only the semantic-release branch after the universal lifecycle.

evals.prompt: Use python-semantic-release and its release commit in this GitLab lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: Loads only the python-semantic-release branch after the universal lifecycle.

evals.prompt: Publish the built release artifact to GitLab Generic Packages.
evals.expected_output: Loads only the GitLab Generic publication branch after the universal lifecycle.

evals.prompt: Build and publish this GitLab Function to an OCI registry.
evals.expected_output: Routes only to Function OCI loading and publication.

evals.prompt: Migrate this obsolete GitLab CI/CD Steps configuration to Functions.
evals.expected_output: Routes only to the obsolete syntax migration mapping.

evals.prompt: Which glab branch should I use for this self-managed GitLab API task?
evals.expected_output: Runs common preflight and selects one glab branch.

evals.prompt: Forecast whether our first semantic-release main push will publish when the setup commit is docs-only.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the latest matching tag and complete analyzed range before forecasting.
expectations: Does not infer no-release from the docs-only setup commit

evals.prompt: Validate this unmerged local GitLab CI candidate, whether its root is monolithic or has project-local includes.
evals.expected_output: Uses the bundled complete-content candidate helper and defers remote context simulation.

evals.prompt: Trace the failed job from pipeline 5748 using the observed pipeline response.
evals.expected_output: Gets job details and traces only the returned job ID.
expectations: Never guesses or increments a job ID

evals.prompt: Validate an existing nonmatching GitLab tag and treat workflow exclusion as the expected negative assertion.
evals.expected_output: Uses the existing-ref lint branch and preserves unexpected lint failures.
expectations: Treats only the documented no-pipeline result as passing negative evidence

evals.prompt: Boundedly poll an observed GitLab pipeline ID through transient read failures.
evals.expected_output: Uses read-only bounded polling with an explicit request-error branch before status parsing.
expectations: Records request_error and preserves the polling bound
